name: Uncle Arnie's | 100mg Drink | Cherry Limeade
description:
Uncle Arnie’s has the tastiest ade for you and your buds! Our refreshingly heady, flavorfully fun THC-infused Cherry Limeade will keep your glasses full and your heads high as you set adrift towards drinking bliss. Get away from the everyday, and float away. Uncle Arnie brings the party, whether its backyards, beaches, boats, or BBQ’s, you’ll set adrift with an onset time of about 20-40mins, and of course sip according to your experience!

VEGAN. MADE IN THE USA.
